build_svs_vamana_index: build a faiss IndexSVSVamana index for sparse vector search with Vamana graph
search_svs_index: search a faiss SVS index for k nearest neighbors of query vectors
save_and_reload_svs_index: write a faiss SVS index to disk and reload it for later search
build_svs_flat_index: build a faiss SVSFlat index using index_factory for exact sparse vector search
build_svs_lvq_index: build a faiss SVS Vamana LVQ compressed index using index_factory or IndexSVSVamanaLVQ
